rationale: The stock is trading near the upper bound of its intraday range (86.7%) after a significant gap-down, indicating that the initial selling pressure has been absorbed but there is no fresh momentum to drive a breakout. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of volume expansion in the last few minutes, while shorting against the immediate upward drift from the lows is counter-trend.
